mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment, as indicated by FEDFUNDS below 0.5%, compresses the risk-free rate and increases the present value of future equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation, measured by CPIAUCSL 12-month year-over-year change exceeding 2.5%, signals central bank tightening and increased real interest rates, which reduce equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL 12m yoy > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment growth (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month signals a tightening labor market that accelerates inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and reduce S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or the interaction effect (measured by the product term) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery phase, a housing starts level (HOUST) above 500,000 units signals strong consumer confidence and rising demand for goods and services, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when the economy is in post-recession recovery and HOUST > 500,000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE above 5.0%) indicates a weak labor market and subdued consumer spending, which suppresses corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0, indicating a contraction in manufacturing and mining output, signals weakening economic activity and reduced corporate profitability, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 90.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and acceleration in inflation (CPIAUCSL 12m yoy > 2.5%) signals an active monetary tightening cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL 12m yoy > 2.5%, or the interaction effect (product term) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of monetary policy normalization, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) relative to the previous 6 months signals the Federal Reserve's shift to a tighter stance, which increases the cost of capital and reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and monetary policy normalization is active, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
